rules: exactly one ledger row exists for every L001-L100
planning baseline begins with all levels PLANNED and no promotion evidence
a level state cannot exceed the highest state allowed by current evidence
PROMOTED levels must be contiguous from L001 for the declared production maturity level
SUSPENDED or ROLLED_BACK prerequisites invalidate dependent higher promotion claims
evidence state must be CURRENT for QUALIFIED or PROMOTED
critical-risk levels require independent current evidence before PROMOTED
ledger updates are evidence-bearing control changes and must not be inferred from prose
